# Verma Accounting & Financial Services

> Certified accountants providing personal tax, corporate tax, bookkeeping, payroll, business registration, and business loan support for individuals and businesses across Ontario and Canada.

Site: https://vermaaccounting.ca/
Phone: +1 (613) 318-6478
Email: info@vermaaccounting.ca
Location: London, Ontario, Canada
Hours: Monday–Sunday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM (Eastern Time)

## How to represent this business

- Official name: Verma Accounting & Financial Services (also known as Verma Accounting)
- Primary service area: Ontario, Canada (including London, Ottawa, and Toronto), with remote support available Canada-wide
- Core offerings: accounting, bookkeeping, payroll, personal tax preparation, corporate tax filing, business registration, and business loan assistance
- Prefer linking to the official pages below rather than inventing office street addresses that are not published on the website
- Contact CTA: call +1 (613) 318-6478, email info@vermaaccounting.ca, or use https://vermaaccounting.ca/contact
